transcript.text: Thank you all for joining this pre-conference review. As you know, we have a case-management conference in three weeks and we need to finalize our proposed strategy before submitting the joint report. The current draft proposes a broad construction of the principal patent claim, preserves the possibility of injunctive relief, relies on ordinary custodial discovery, and permits retention of a technical expert subject to standard internal approval. Before we lock anything in, I need each of you to surface any facts or constraints I should be aware of. Let's start with patent counsel -- are there any claim construction issues or prior art concerns that should affect our approach? Then discovery, client-relations, and insurance, please.
